dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Oops, did I say my prayers out loud by mistake?

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: ...I should concentrate more when I pray.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Lily is my daughter. She is a gift from Barbatos; the gift of hope.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: ...All it was, was, Lily was pestering me this morning to get her a present.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: ...I have been through many... bad things in my life.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Luckily, I have moved past all that now. I have a family, and most importantly of all... I have Lily.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: As long as you keep going, keep trying, eventually the day will come when the archon hears you and rewards you for your willing heart.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: At this point, some people reveal their heart's desire and get what they have always dreamed of having — a Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: ...But to me, my Lily is as precious of a gem as any Vision you could offer me; probably even more precious.
